content: Current competitor products converge on fixture forecasts, probability views, fair/no-vig odds, value/EV signals, multiple markets, and public model-performance history. MetricKick and Sportmonks both emphasize probability-vs-market comparison and transparent performance; Sportmonks exposes log loss and predictability by league. Differentiation should therefore come from auditable snapshots, calibration, data-quality explanations, and honest no-value states rather than a larger pick feed.
